summary: Added §11's economy to the pure ledger. Content: ruinGold 40, supplyCacheGold 25, rumorPrice 25, tonicPrice 30, tonicTicks 240, tonicCarryLimit 2 in objectiveRules, plus grantAmount/itemPrice and GOLD_GRANT_REASONS/SHOP_ITEMS; the validator is extended and a test refuses a negative price and a carry limit of 0. Simulation: new economy.ts with grantGold (keyed: ruin per player+key, supply-cache per key match-wide; duplicate/already-claimed), purchase (request ids unique; a matching repeat returns the original record with replayed:true and the same state, even at a stale tick; a mismatched reuse is duplicate; refusals insufficient-gold, player-in-duel, player-disconnected, player-left, tonic-limit), useTonic/activeTonic (active on ticks start..start+239; refusals tonic-active, no-tonic, not-at-sea, grappled, player-in-duel, player-disconnected). State gains goldSpent, grants, purchases, and per-player tonics/tonicEffect. Leaving drops tonics; a duel loss keeps them. The invariant is now balances + goldSpent = goldIssued, with grant-key uniqueness, grant amounts, purchase-id uniqueness, the purchases summing to goldSpent, and tonic bounds. Scripted tests in ledger.test.ts use the Run harness, which gained an optional rules argument. Property tests add an economy stream on its own seeded dice, interleaved so the existing sequences and their coverage are unchanged, with per-step gold and tonic checks and 23 new EXERCISED entries. docs/objectives.md has an Economy section. Checks run in this worktree after npm ci: npm run typecheck, npm run test:unit (644 passed), npm run test:integration (36 passed) and npm run build (smoke passed), all exit 0.
open_assumptions: A repeated purchase id with the same player and item returns ok:true, replayed:true and the original PurchaseRecord (rather than ok:false 'duplicate'), so the caller must check replayed before delivering a rumor. The same id reused with a different player or item is rejected as 'duplicate'.
The request-id lookup runs before the stale-tick check, so a retry always finds its original purchase.
Purchases and tonic use refuse disconnected players (player-disconnected), as channels do. Grants are allowed while disconnected or in a duel, and refused only for players who left or are unknown.
useTonic takes a required 'grappled' boolean in the request, and the ledger refuses it with 'grappled'.
The Haki focus scroll is out of scope (alpha-only), as decisions.md records.
untested: The rumor purchase flow with the intel module is only documented; no code or test wires purchase to intel, which is deferred to objectives-endgame.
The tonic's +10 % sailing effect is not applied anywhere yet; only activeTonic is tested.
verify_yourself: That returning ok:true with replayed:true for a repeated purchase request id (rather than an ok:false 'duplicate' rejection) is the result shape the objectives-endgame wiring and the intel module expect.
